title: nan
authors: Habib N.; Flores-Abad A.; Martínez-Martínez J.; Aponte-Roa D.A.; Espinoza A.A.
key_contribution: Presents an optical flow and sonar sensor fusion navigation architecture using EKF position estimation and ROS fake GPS topics for autonomous quadcopter inspection in GNSS-denied power plants.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
